title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 9: Yahweh appears to Solomon a second time, and Solomon's cities, workers and ships.

questions.text: Yahweh appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared to him where?
questions.explanation: Yahweh appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.

questions.text: What did Yahweh say would be in the house perpetually?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he had made the house holy to put his name there forever, and "my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually."

questions.text: What would Israel become among all peoples if they served other gods?
questions.explanation: If they served other gods, Yahweh would cut off Israel, and Israel would be a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

answers.text: A land of milk and honey

questions.text: What did King Solomon give to Hiram?
questions.explanation: King Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

answers.text: Twenty cities in the land of Galilee
Twenty ships of the Red Sea

questions.text: What did Hiram call the cities Solomon gave him?
questions.explanation: Hiram came to see the cities, they did not please him, and he called them the land of Cabul.

questions.text: Which city did Pharaoh burn and give as a wedding gift to his daughter, Solomon's wife?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh king of Egypt had taken Gezer, burned it with fire, and given it as a wedding gift to his daughter.

questions.text: From whom did Solomon raise a levy of bondservants?
questions.explanation: Solomon raised a levy of bondservants from the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites left in the land.

answers.text: Non-Israelite peoples left in the land
Hiram's servants from the city of Tyre

questions.text: How often did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar?
questions.explanation: Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar he built to Yahweh three times per year.

questions.text: Where did King Solomon make a fleet of ships?
questions.explanation: King Solomon made a fleet of ships in Ezion Geber, beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.

questions.text: From where did the fleet fetch four hundred and twenty talents of gold?
questions.explanation: Hiram's servants went in the fleet with Solomon's servants; they came to Ophir and fetched four hundred and twenty talents of gold.
